body: FORMAL CONTENT BLOCK on cand-1EE04BNN2PY3AKNAFP32YK42YD, exact 77e62ef0d95b7050a5fd1e685de6ec47ad9dad75. The plan at line 142 says every decoder-claimed record remains `unchecked` through C1, D0, and D1. That contradicts both the accepted V11 decision point 6 and the candidate design record at lines 5590 and 5619, which say such records remain `draft`. The distinction is substantive in this architecture: content checking, receipt integrity, and observation authority are separate claims. A self-consistent caller record may pass content and identity checks while remaining Draft for observation authority; calling the whole record Unchecked collapses those axes. The same plan paragraph exposes the contradiction by saying generic codec rehydration is draft at line 148 and a self-consistent whole receipt remains draft at line 157. Minimal repair: replace `unchecked` with `draft`, or explicitly name orthogonal ContentCheckState and ObservationAuthority states without withholding content validation until E0. No other semantic blocker found: exact two-path scope and blob hashes match the frozen V11 record, diff-check is clean, identities derive from complete preimages, C1 is synthetic/fixture scoped, D0/D1 stay decoder free, and only separately authorized E0 owns the issuance join. The unauthorized pre-landing HOLD remains independent and is not cured by a content successor or review.
